as_told.title: Holloman Air Force Base landing and meeting with generals
as_told.place_text: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

related.note: Both are James Fox telling of a UFO landing at Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico. This telling ties the landing to a claimed meeting with Eisenhower, while the story places it in 1964 and rests it on footage Allan Sandler saw. Those are competing accounts of when the landing happened and who was there, so either could be right.

plain: The story is that a craft from elsewhere landed at Holloman Air Force Base in New Mexico, and that its occupants met military officers there. James Fox, a filmmaker who has spent decades investigating UFOs, tells Michels he has come round to it: 'a landing did happen at Holloman Air Force Base, now I'm kind of convinced that it did.' He links it to President Eisenhower. Michels describes it himself in a later episode as a landing with 'a possible interaction between some generals on the base and these tall beings.' He traces the story to the 1974 documentary UFOs: Past, Present and Future, made by the producer Bob Emenegger and narrated by Rod Serling, the creator of The Twilight Zone. The two tellers give no date for the event. If true, it would be a face-to-face meeting between the US military and nonhuman visitors on an American base. Film said to show the landing has since been read by others as an ordinary jet.
